_note: FireRay LED Perimeter uses a sku-selector configurator (not dynamic_build) — every skuOptions entry below is a real, confirmed SKU from shopify-variant-index.json. Zone denotes the FireRay housing size/series (4, 6, 7, 9). Mount Style denotes the fixture family: A1/B1/R1 are legacy fixed single-color fixtures, C1 is the selectable single-color fixture, C2 is the selectable dual-color fixture. Zone 4 core SKUs use a legacy "C" segment instead of "C1" and mix single-color (FR4C-A, FR4C-B) and dual-color (FR4C-AW) offerings under that one code — flagged needs_verification since it does not follow the clean C1/C2 split used by Zones 6/7/9. Do NOT invent prices; resolved at runtime from shopify-variant-index.json.
